title: Testing
description: Practices for tests that actually catch defects.

practices.title: Test behavior, not implementation
practices.statement: Test observable behavior; tests coupled to internal details break on safe refactors.

practices.title: Tests are deterministic
practices.statement: Tests must not depend on wall-clock time, scheduling order, randomness, or network availability.

practices.title: Isolated tests
practices.statement: Each test sets up its own state; shared mutable fixtures cause order-dependent failures.

practices.title: Lock in fixed defects
practices.statement: Every fixed defect gets a test that fails without the fix.

practices.title: Assert expected values
practices.statement: Assert the expected value, not merely that no error occurred.
